grade_evidence: Not WRONG: the owner's theorem, with its hypotheses exactly as written at axial.py:186-187, is re-derived and agrees (C1, C2). NARROWED: the owner's 'asymptotic flatness' (W' -> 1) is a strictly smaller class than the cylindrical literature's flat-or-string asymptotics (the vocabulary is from a search restatement, NOT READ; the narrowness itself is COMPUTED): (i) it excludes every u >= 0 static cylinder with mu > 0 (C3: k = 1 - 4 mu); (ii) under it, u >= 0 everywhere forces u == 0 regardless of contraction (C4), so the ledger's 'ANY axial contraction forces u < 0 somewhere' (ledger.py:1962) is a property of the boundary condition; (iii) on the wider conical class the conclusion fails: explicit regular-axis contracting profile with u >= 0 everywhere (8 pi u(0) = 1/10, min on grid >= 0, tail ratio 1) and, with Phi = Psi, u + p_i >= 0 for all i on the grid (C6). The rests_on_it entries (ledger O4, specthm H_axial/R2/O4/K4) hold on the owner's class and not beyond it.
